_readme: Opening days derived by hand from the Notion 'Opening Hours' text. days: 0=Sun..6=Sat. Places where the text gives no weekday pattern are omitted (shown as 'check hours'). seasons: MM-DD ranges, year-agnostic (a range with from > to wraps the new year), optional per-season days overriding days; optional year = year the dates were checked; Easter dates are 2026's.

Cueva de Chufín.seasonNote: Open Easter (2–5 Apr 2026) and 15 Jun–15 Sep only

Laberinto de Villapresente.seasonNote: Open 28 Mar–12 Oct in 2026: Wed–Sun, daily in July and August
